clips.title: The story
paras: At Whelgar's Excavation in the Wetlands, Ados Fragment lies among three lost pieces of the Goaz Stone. Together, the four shards make an ancient relic carved with Titan inscriptions.

The Ados Fragment is one of four pieces Prospector Whelgar needs to restore the Goaz Stone at Whelgar's Excavation. Before raptors overran the dig site, Whelgar began translating the main tablet and found its inscriptions broke off at crucial moments. The four pieces, named Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru, were lost across the ruins in ancient containers and dirt mounds, among prowling beasts.
